summary: Gives recommendations for how a stateless IPv4/IPv6 translator should translate source addresses of ICMPv6 packets when the address cannot be translated to IPv4. Such packets should still be passed across the translator as ICMP packets directed to the IPv4 destination. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: A translator turns IPv6 messages into IPv4 ones. Sometimes the sender's address does not fit in the old format, so this memo says what to put there.

questions: what if icmpv6 source is not translatable
